servicesPage.intro: From routine maintenance to major repairs, JP Auto Service offers a full range of automotive services backed by expertise and integrity. Our certified mechanics use advanced diagnostics and quality parts to keep your vehicle performing at its best.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics & Repair
services.shortDescription: Accurate diagnostics and expert repairs for all engine issues.
services.longDescription: Is your check engine light on? Our advanced diagnostic tools pinpoint the problem quickly. From minor sensor replacements to major overhauls, we restore your engine's performance and reliability.

process.title: Comprehensive Scan
process.description: We connect your vehicle to our diagnostic computer to read error codes and live data.

process.title: In-Depth Inspection
process.description: Our technician performs a visual and mechanical inspection to confirm the root cause.

process.title: Repair & Verification
process.description: We complete the repair using quality parts, then test-drive to ensure the issue is resolved.

faqs.question: How long does an engine diagnostic take?
faqs.answer: Most diagnostics take 30-60 minutes. Repairs vary based on complexity.

faqs.question: Do you offer a warranty on engine repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, all engine repairs come with a 12-month/12,000-mile warranty.

services.title: Brake Service & Repair
services.shortDescription: Keep your brakes responsive and safe with our expert service.
services.longDescription: Your safety depends on reliable brakes. We inspect pads, rotors, calipers, and fluid levels to ensure optimal stopping power. Whether you need a pad replacement or a full brake system overhaul, we have you covered.
benefits: Enhanced safety for you and your family

process.title: Brake Inspection
process.description: We measure pad thickness, rotor condition, and check for leaks.

process.title: Component Replacement
process.description: Worn pads and rotors are replaced with high-quality parts.

process.title: System Test
process.description: We test the brakes on the road to confirm smooth, quiet operation.

faqs.question: How often should I replace my brake pads?
faqs.answer: Typically every 30,000-50,000 miles, but it depends on driving habits.

faqs.question: What are signs of brake trouble?
faqs.answer: Squealing, grinding, a soft pedal, or vibration when braking.

services.title: Oil Change & Fluid Services
services.shortDescription: Regular oil changes to keep your engine running smoothly.
services.longDescription: Routine oil changes are the best way to protect your engine. We use quality oils and filters, and also check all other fluids (coolant, transmission, brake, power steering) to keep your vehicle in top shape.

process.title: Drain Old Oil
process.description: We safely drain the old oil and replace the filter.

process.title: Refill with New Oil
process.description: We add the correct grade and amount of oil for your vehicle.

process.title: Fluid Check & Top-Off
process.description: We inspect and top off all other fluids as needed.

faqs.question: What type of oil do you use?
faqs.answer: We offer conventional, synthetic blend, and full synthetic options to match your vehicle's requirements.

faqs.question: How often should I get an oil change?
faqs.answer: Most modern cars need one every 5,000-7,500 miles, but check your owner's manual.

services.title: Tire Services & Alignment
services.shortDescription: Extend tire life and improve handling with our tire services.
services.longDescription: Proper tire maintenance ensures safety and efficiency. We offer tire rotation, balancing, mounting, and wheel alignment to promote even wear, better fuel economy, and a smoother ride.
benefits: Even tire wear for longer life

process.title: Tire Inspection
process.description: We check tread depth, pressure, and overall condition.

process.title: Rotation & Balancing
process.description: Tires are rotated and balanced to prevent uneven wear.

process.title: Alignment Check
process.description: We adjust angles to manufacturer specs for optimal handling.

faqs.question: How often should I rotate my tires?
faqs.answer: Every 5,000-7,500 miles, typically during an oil change.

faqs.question: Do I need an alignment if my car pulls to one side?
faqs.answer: Yes, that's a common sign of misalignment. We can check and correct it.

about.headline: Your Trusted Dallas Auto Repair Shop
about.mission: To provide honest, high-quality automotive service that keeps our community safe and mobile, with transparency and integrity at every step.
story: JP Auto Service was founded in 2008 by John P., a master technician with over 20 years of experience. Starting as a small two-bay shop on Rowan Avenue, John built a reputation for meticulous work and fair pricing. Word spread quickly among Dallas residents who were tired of high-pressure sales and shoddy repairs.

Over the years, we've grown into a full-service auto repair facility serving the entire Dallas metro area. Our team of ASE-certified mechanics shares John's commitment to excellence. We invest in the latest diagnostic equipment and ongoing training to handle everything from vintage cars to the latest hybrids. At JP Auto Service, you're not just a customer—you're a neighbor.
